---
title: "CHIP summaries"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

CHIP is analyzed at the variant level among valid ctDNA results using the SAP
model: a Bayesian logistic regression with an age spline and patient and gene
random intercepts. A separate patient summary counts any CHIP variant during
follow-up among patients with detectable, valid ctDNA.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_chip"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
variant_summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "chip-variant-summary.parquet")
patient_summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "chip-patient-summary.parquet")
draws_path <- file.path(result_dir, "chip-age-draws.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "chip-age-posterior.svg")
model_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("analysis", "04-implementation", "models"))
model_path <- file.path(model_dir, "chip-variant-model.rds")
alterations_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                              "analysis-alterations.parquet")
cohort_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                         "analysis-cohort.parquet")
if (!file.exists(alterations_path) || !file.exists(cohort_path)) {
  stop("CHIP analysis requires the built alteration table and cohort.")
}
input_paths <- c(alterations_path, cohort_path,
                 private_domain_path(config, "alterations"),
                 private_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "alterations"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"))
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(variant_summary_path, patient_summary_path, draws_path, figure_path, model_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "05-chip.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  chip_variant_summary <- read_result_table(variant_summary_path)
  chip_patient_summary <- read_result_table(patient_summary_path)
} else {
  alterations <- read_result_table(alterations_path)
  cohort <- read_result_table(cohort_path)
  require_public_columns(alterations,
                         c("id", "variant_id", "gene_id", "chip_suspicion",
                           "valid_ctdna_result", "ctdna_detected"),
                         "CHIP variant analysis")
  require_public_columns(cohort, c("id", "age"), "CHIP age covariate")
  chip_data <- merge(
    alterations,
    cohort[, c("id", "age"), drop = FALSE],
    by = "id", all.x = TRUE, suffixes = c("", ".cohort")
  )
  chip_data$age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(chip_data$age)))
  chip_data$chip_suspicion <- validate_binary(chip_data$chip_suspicion,
                                              "chip_suspicion")
  chip_data$ctdna_detected <- validate_binary(chip_data$ctdna_detected,
                                              "ctdna_detected")
  valid <- !is.na(chip_data$valid_ctdna_result) &
    as.logical(chip_data$valid_ctdna_result) &
    !is.na(chip_data$chip_suspicion) & !is.na(chip_data$age) &
    !is.na(chip_data$gene_id) & nzchar(as.character(chip_data$gene_id))
  model_data <- chip_data[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(model_data) == 0L) stop("No complete valid variants support the CHIP model.")
  if (!requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'brms' is required for the variant-level CHIP model.")
  }
  fit <- brms::brm(
    chip_suspicion ~ splines::ns(age, df = 2) + (1 | id) + (1 | gene_id),
    data = model_data,
    family = brms::bernoulli(link = "logit"),
    iter = 2000,
    chains = 4,
    cores = 1,
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", offset = 3L),
    refresh = 0,
    file = model_path
  )
  chip <- validate_binary(model_data$chip_suspicion, "chip_suspicion")
  observed_chip <- !is.na(chip)
  chip_variant_summary <- data.frame(
    variants = length(unique(model_data$variant_id[
      observed_chip & !is.na(model_data$variant_id)
    ])),
    patients = length(unique(model_data$id[
      observed_chip & !is.na(model_data$id)
    ])),
    chip_variants = sum(chip == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    chip_rate = if (sum(observed_chip) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      mean(chip[observed_chip] == 1),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  chip_variant_summary$n_valid_variants <- nrow(model_data)
  chip_variant_summary$n_valid_patients <- length(unique(model_data$id))
  valid_detected <- !is.na(chip_data$valid_ctdna_result) &
    as.logical(chip_data$valid_ctdna_result) &
    !is.na(chip_data$ctdna_detected) & chip_data$ctdna_detected == 1 &
    !is.na(chip_data$id)
  chip_values <- validate_binary(chip_data$chip_suspicion, "chip_suspicion")
  follow_up_ids <- unique(chip_data$id[valid_detected])
  any_chip <- vapply(follow_up_ids, function(identifier) {
    any(chip_values[valid_detected & chip_data$id == identifier] == 1,
        na.rm = TRUE)
  }, logical(1))
  chip_patient_summary <- data.frame(
    denominator = length(follow_up_ids),
    patients_with_chip = sum(any_chip),
    proportion_with_chip = if (length(follow_up_ids) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      mean(any_chip),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  age_grid <- data.frame(age = seq(
    min(model_data$age), max(model_data$age), length.out = 50L
  ))
  age_draw_matrix <- brms::posterior_epred(fit, newdata = age_grid, re_formula = NA)
  age_draws <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(age_draw_matrix)), function(index) {
    data.frame(age = age_grid$age, draw = as.numeric(age_draw_matrix[index, ]),
               draw_id = index, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
  write_module_table(chip_variant_summary, variant_summary_path)
  write_module_table(chip_patient_summary, patient_summary_path)
  write_module_draws(age_draws, draws_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the CHIP figure.")
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(age_draws, ggplot2::aes(age, draw)) +
    ggplot2::stat_summary(fun = stats::median, geom = "line") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Age at random selection (years)",
                  y = "Posterior probability of CHIP") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "fit", model = "variant_age_spline_patient_gene_random_intercepts"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "05-chip.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-summary
#| tbl-cap: "CHIP variant-level summary"

chip_variant_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: chip-patient-summary
#| tbl-cap: "CHIP patient-level follow-up summary"

chip_patient_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
